from pathlib import Path
import json,time

home=Path.home()
data=home/".local/share/prediction-chat-bridge"
states=home/".local/state/prediction-command-bus/tasks"
tid="DEV-PRED-CONT-CANARY2-A-20261003-E022"
cid="CONT-e91d594cb6c782b9e7b2668d"

def load(p):
    try:return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:return None

s=load(states/f"{tid}.json")
route=load(data/"routes"/f"{tid}.json")
cp=data/"continuations"/f"{cid}.json"

event_path=None
event=None
for p in (data/"inflight").glob("*.json"):
    o=load(p)
    if isinstance(o,dict) and o.get("task_id")==tid:
        event_path=p
        event=o
        break

checks=[
 ("STATE",isinstance(s,dict)),
 ("DISPATCHED",isinstance(s,dict) and s.get("status")=="DISPATCHED"),
 ("AUTO",isinstance(s,dict) and s.get("auto_continue") is True),
 ("ROUTE",isinstance(route,dict) and bool(route.get("chat_id"))),
 ("INFLIGHT",event_path is not None),
 ("NO_CONT",not cp.exists()),
]
for name,ok in checks:
    if not ok:
        print("HEARTBEAT_ELIGIBILITY=BLOCKED_"+name,flush=True)
        raise SystemExit(20)

created=event.get("created_at") if isinstance(event,dict) else None
try:
    created=float(created)
except Exception:
    created=event_path.stat().st_mtime
age=time.time()-created
if age<45:
    print("HEARTBEAT_ELIGIBILITY=TOO_FRESH age="+str(round(age,1)),flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(21)

print("HEARTBEAT_ELIGIBILITY=YES age="+str(round(age,1))+" chat="+str(route.get("chat_id")),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(22)
